diacritics.Dvůr: D-v-ů-r (ů has a RING above, not an acute) — never Dvur
diacritics.Králové: K-r-á-l-o-v-é (á acute + é acute) — never Kralove
diacritics.ZÁLEŽÍ: Z-Á-L-E-Ž-Í (Á acute, Ž caron, Í acute) — never ZALEZI
diacritics.tújí: t-ú-j-í (ú has an ACUTE, not a ring) — never tuji
diacritics.Čištění: Č-i-š-t-ě-n-í (Č caron, š caron, ě caron, í acute) — never Cisteni
diacritics.zákazníků: á + í + ů RING — never zakazniku
diacritics.zdarma: no diacritics but keep lowercase after middle dot

criteria.desc: every Czech word correct; one wrong accent is a hard fail
dark emerald + corner brackets + lockup + headline ladder present
no artefacts, no deformed or doubled letters
three tiers, correct colours (ghost/white/green), full stop at end
hues match tokens, no foreign colour
exactly one glowing CTA, phone legible at 2 m
person not redrawn, correct orientation, blended into dark

hard_fails: visible technical annotation (px, mm, ZONE, font name)
duplicated unique element (logo, CTA, proof card)
second glowing element besides the CTA

thresholds.92-100: publish + set as new baseline for this format
thresholds.65-79: one targeted iteration (fix exactly one thing)
thresholds.0-64: discard, regenerate with a different variant vector
